Definition: from the same as G5157; a turn, i.e. (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character:--(even) as, conversation, (+ like) manner, (+ by any) means, way.
BiblicalUsage: trópos means a turn, i.e. mode or style. It appears 13 times in Scripture, including Acts 1:11 and Hebrews 13:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe trópos shows how carefully God chose His words, and this one earns its place.
